mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds consistently across monetary policy cycles.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS on 20-day forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting central bank rate cuts and reducing equity risk premiums, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0, or the Rank IC for UNRATE on 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is high and the unemployment rate is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to labor market weakness, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) fails to produce a negative Rank IC (below 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return signal is not observed in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions marked by strong housing starts (HOUST) and robust GDP growth (GDPC1), the expectation of imminent monetary policy tightening due to overheating drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods, or the Rank IC for the demand regime signal is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO on 5-day forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between INDPRO and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 305.0 (indicating elevated inflation) triggers central bank hawkishness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 305.0, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL on 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor markets characterized by strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE), the expectation of persistent inflation and monetary policy tightening drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of tight labor market periods, or the Rank IC for the labor regime signal is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS on 5-day forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between RSAFS and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
